name: bookmark
description: Represents saving or bookmarking for later. On hover the bookmark jumps, stretches, and squashes onto the ground with a bubble of effort and twin impact dust.

provenance.notes: Base bookmark path picked from a third-party icon site by the maintainer and animated via Gemini; exact source site unconfirmed (16x16 grid suggests Bootstrap Icons, MIT — UNVERIFIED, confirm before use). License status: pending human review — confirm the source site before promoting to stable. Documented intentional 16x16 viewBox deviation to preserve the contributed geometry exactly.

animation.description: The bookmark jumps (y -4), stretches (scaleY 1.15), and squashes onto the ground (scaleY 0.75, scaleX 1.25) pivoting at its base (8, 15.5), then settles (0.6s easeInOut). A bubble floats up as it jumps; twin dust puffs fire at the 0.3s impact moment. One-shot, ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context for what is being saved when used in a button.
